subject: E-Commerce
title: Why Marketplaces Win
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Why Marketplaces Win.

hook.text: Marketplace platforms now sell 67% of all e-commerce. Third-party sellers on other people's platforms dominate online.

buildup.text: Marketplaces win because of network effects: more sellers attract more buyers, which attract more sellers.

discovery.text: Amazon, eBay, Alibaba, Mercado Libre, and Shopee host millions of sellers each.

twist.text: Marketplace dominance means most brands don't own their customer relationship. The platform sits between seller & buyer.

climax.text: Marketplaces won e-commerce by offering convenience and selection. Brands traded independence for access to traffic.

punchline.text: 67% of e-commerce through marketplaces. Selling on someone else's platform.

quiz.question: What percentage of e-commerce now happens through marketplace platforms?
